development_selection: Per star method, maximize nominal-body solved count; ties use map-mean paired common-valid processed length, otherwise retain default5. No held-out selection.
rrt_connect_policy: Repeated unchanged bidirectional attempts with prospective seeds; original first-attempt regression is separate
neighbor_rule: RRT* radius min(eta, gamma*(log(n)/n)^(1/3)); gamma uses workspace volume as conservative free-volume upper bound, factor1.1 above the paper sufficient threshold
informed_bound: Raw tree best cost; no processed path feedback, no pruning
postprocessing: Identical greedy shortcut, every raw improvement independently certified first; search, verification and shortcut all consume the global budget

vehicle.parameter_status: Illustrative simulation assumptions, no confirmed real vehicle specification
vehicle.body_model: Sphere circumscribing the orientation-independent length2 cylinder: radius=sqrt((length/2)^2+(diameter/2)^2)

kinematics.parameter_status: Illustrative no-current forward-only kinematics, not identified hydrodynamics or 6DOF
kinematics.initial_attitude: Same map-fixed yaw toward goal and zero pitch for every method
kinematics.terminal_attitude: Unconstrained; position-only goal with stated tolerance
kinematics.continuous_safety: Exact constant-rate integration; chord swept sphere enlarged by v*sqrt(yaw_rate^2+pitch_rate^2)*dt^2/8 bounds curved inter-step motion
kinematics.evaluation: Track selected processed and raw paths separately, deduplicate identical coordinates; point plans must pass nominal-body geometry before tracking

near_seabed.surface: Seeded Gaussian heights rasterized upward to 0.5m steps; h(x,y) is the resulting piecewise-constant closed-column surface
near_seabed.mission_band: Entire conservative body must fit between closed seabed and virtual h+6 ceiling; ceiling violations are mission constraint failures, separate from physical obstacle collision

statistics: Map-level means and paired summaries; 6 held-out maps are not90 independent maps; no significance claim from5 seeds
failure_policy: Stop on accepted unsafe paths or program errors; preserve all trials. Budgets, invalid inputs and analytically unreachable scales are separate.
resource_policy: Fresh serial single-core normal-priority workers, BLAS/VTK threads1, no GPU. Full coordinates once outside repository. Record planning/validation/postprocess/tracking/diagnostic time separately.
staging: Commit protocol before search; pilot seed0 then1/2; development only; commit selected parameters and resource gate before270 held-out tasks. If functional safety fails, no formal expansion. Never remove difficult maps after outcomes.
